newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were moderately active. Compared with last Wednesday, both classes were $0.50 lower, instances $1.00 lower.
Steers - high select and choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 62.00- 64.00. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 59.00-62.00. Select 1-2 56.00-59.00.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 62.00- 63.50. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 58.00-62.00. Select 1-2 56.00-58.50.
